centering: Arithmetic position and velocity means of the observed initial scene; no future state.
normalization: Training-only feature means and population standard deviations, weighted equally by scene; constant columns use scale 1.
model: Separate affine map with six outputs at each horizon; add predicted residuals to constant-velocity extrapolation. Direct predictions from t=0, not autoregressive rollouts.
training_loss: Sum of squared errors per output, with row weight 1/(number_of_train_scenes * particles_in_scene), plus alpha times squared coefficient norm; intercept unpenalized.
selection: One alpha for all horizons; minimize sqrt(mean over validation scenes and horizons of ((position_rmse/t^2)^2 + (velocity_rmse/t)^2)/2). Exact ties prefer larger alpha. No refit on validation.
test_reporting: After saving the selected model, evaluate each test scene and horizon once; report per-coordinate position/velocity RMSE and arithmetic mean of scene RMSEs at each horizon. Preserve all failures; no test-dependent tuning or pass threshold.
limitations: Only 3 train, 2 validation and 5 test scenes; published synthetic targets are reserved from fitting and selection, not a blind benchmark.
Training material parameters are constant, so this baseline cannot identify effects of changed stiffness or viscosity.
The coordinate-wise affine matrix is not constrained to rotation equivariance or conservation.
No walls in this corpus, no calibrated water, no learned graph or JEPA runtime, no latency or memory measurement.
